EXACT-SHA HOLD on a190f17aa22f68e17d03414b7381b0bf88467c76. Complete 18fe290..a190f17 delta reviewed. finiteWeightedMean closes WeightedMean and is reused by both kernel paths, but the measured seven-branch population is not closed.

Unchanged scalar branches still call Estimate.observed directly: Sum(vs.sum), Mean(vs.sum / size), Variance(variance(vs)), and Slope(...)(Estimate.observed). Scout runnable evidence at post-01M17J8YDMX4TNGP32T3S7CV1E shows finite MaxValue inputs produce Observed(+Inf) for Sum/Mean/Variance and Observed(-Inf) for Slope. The only new overflow court is WeightedMean.

Required candidate: every derived scalar branch passes through Estimate.score or an equivalent finite-result constructor; aggregate courts name Sum, Mean, Variance, Slope, WeightedMean, scalar Kernel, and kernelAt, with Maximum as the finite control. The author worktree is now dirty after a190f17, so I am not inspecting the moving repair. No additional finding in the frozen delta.
